item.title: Recent ABC7 contests, promotions, sweepstakes winners
item.description: Here are the winners for all recent ABC7 contests, promotions and sweepstakes. They are listed for at least thirty (30) days after the winner(s) are notified or announced.

item.title: Jared Keeso's hockey comedy 'Shoresy' returns for Season 5, a showdown of North America vs. Europe
item.description: Shoresy is protecting the Bulldog's way of play. Watch the official trailer for "Shoresy" Season 5, streaming Feb. 21 on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Disney Jr. sets March premiere dates for preschool series "BeddyByes" and "Magicampers"
item.description: From magical camp adventures to cozy sleep routines, Disney Jr.'s latest shows are almost here! Watch the premieres of "BeddyByes" on March 2 and "Magicampers" on March 23 streaming the next day on Disney+.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Some overnight fog, then sun breaks through in the morning
item.description: Areas of fog will form overnight and it will become dense in the morning. The sun will break through, but high clouds will begin to filter the sun in the afternoon.

item.title: Santa Cruz mountain lions among population officially classified as threatened species
item.description: On Thursday, the California Fish and Game Commission voted to increase puma protections for a group of mountain lions by listing them on the threatened species list.

item.title: BART considers layoffs, station closures, reduced services to balance budget deficit
item.description: If drastic service cuts are adopted, it would set BART back by 50 years.

item.title: Minnesota man indicted after allegedly impersonating FBI agent to break Luigi Mangione out of jail
item.description: Mark Anderson, 36, allegedly went to the Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn on Jan. 28 posing as a federal agent and claimed to have a court order to release Mangione.

item.title: SF supervisors grill PG&E officials about mass outage last December, demanding accountability
item.description: San Francisco supervisors are demanding answers about what caused the widespread PG&E power outages that impacted businesses and residents back in December.

item.title: San Francisco schools to be closed Friday as teachers' strike continues
item.description: "Right now I'm not trying to spend on anything because I don't know for how long I have to stretch what I have," said Aurora Hernandez, a preschool teacher with SFUSD.

item.title: Traveling to Tahoe for the long weekend? Here are your best chances to go
item.description: Thinking of hitting the slopes in Lake Tahoe for the holiday weekend? Your best chances for travel is in the next few days before another series of storms arrives, ABC7 Meteorologist Drew Tuma says.
